name: com.github.euzee.permission.PermissionActivity
description: Euzee's permissionUtil library opens this Activity when an app requests contacts, calendar, storage, location, camera, microphone, phone, sensor, or SMS access. If the app supplied an explanation for a permission Android previously denied, the screen shows it before asking Android for access.
disableEffect: Features that use this library to request runtime access may no longer reach the data or device functions they need.
